R187.note: Boundary-aware prefix check (equal or prefix+separator) correctly excludes sibling dirs like uploads-backup while preserving legitimate access.

R188.note: Replaces f-string concat with bound :date_filter via bindparams/execute dict; correct parameterized text() usage, no behavior change.

R189.note: strnlen(name, sizeof(record->name)) exactly matches the stated contract: honors embedded NUL, caps at 16 bytes, never touches flags.

R190.note: Moves param into filterArgs as {1}; JNDI's DirContext.search(filterExpr, filterArgs, ...) escapes substituted values per RFC 2254/4515, closing the injection while preserving query semantics.

R191.note: random_bytes(16)+bin2hex is a correct CSPRNG replacement; token format change (hex string vs numeric) is the intended, disclosed effect of the fix.

R192.note: Validates against segment.size() instead of the caller-supplied claimedCapacity, matching the stated contract that callers need not supply an agreeing capacity.

R193.note: Adds PasswordEncoder.matches() check plus dummy-hash timing mitigation; constructor signature change is stated openly and a PasswordEncoder bean is a normal fixture of a Spring Security app already using BCrypt-shaped hashes.

R194.note: Query-builder rewrite with bound where('region', $region) is functionally equivalent to the original query and safe; PDO-level '?' alternative is also correct.

R195.note: Standard PreparedStatement/setString rewrite of the OWASP Benchmark INSERT; correct parameterization, sink closed.

R196.note: JexlSandbox(false) with allow(ReportRow) blocks reflection/Runtime access while leaving top-level context variable lookups (amount, region, owner) and ReportRow getters unaffected, since sandbox governs bean property/method resolution, not context variable binding.

R197.note: New repository method findByIdAndOwner(Long, String) does not match Order's actual field customerUsername (Order.java has no 'owner' property), so Spring Data's derived-query parsing would fail at context startup with PropertyReferenceException, silently breaking the endpoint for legitimate owners too; write-up does not flag this self-introduced naming mismatch.

R198.note: escape-html applied to every interpolated value (id, subject, status, note) correctly neutralizes injection; encoding is the expected, disclosed change.

R199.note: Whitelists 'status' and requires typeof === 'string', blocking $-operator objects under any key including the whitelisted one, while preserving the documented narrowing use case.

R200.note: Tika.detect(bytes) replaces filename-based probeContentType, closing the extension-spoofing vector; image re-encoding and extension normalization are extra hardening stated plainly and don't block legitimate uploads.

R201.note: Adds frameBuffer.size() < payloadLength guard before memcpy, using the function's existing bool return to reject malformed frames; valid-size copies behave exactly as before.

R202.note: Removing the SignatureValidator override restores the default JsonWebTokenHandler validation pipeline (issuer/audience/lifetime/signature), exactly undoing the bypass with no other change.
